title: About the Author
text: ABOUT THE AUTHOR Andy Weir built a career as a software engineer until the success of his first published novel, The Martian, allowed him to live out his dream of writing full-time. He is a lifelong space nerd and a devoted hobbyist of subjects such as relativistic physics, orbital mechanics, and the history of manned spaceflight. He also mixes a mean cocktail. He lives in California. Andyweirauthor.com Facebook.com/AndyWeirAuthor Twitter: @andyweirauthor
